bio.text: Jason Gibbs, a Republican, has served on the Santa Clarita City Council since 2020, including a term as mayor, and is a candidate for California's 27th Congressional District in 2026.

According to his campaign website, he earned bachelor's and master's degrees in mechanical engineering from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo and worked in the aerospace industry on Delta II, Delta IV and Atlas V rocket launch systems.
The site says he lives in Santa Clarita with his wife and two children.
